title: The Good Father at the Bad Place
subtitle: Presence matters more than a flawless outing
sourceCredit: Ron Hart · The Moth Radio Hour, “Starting Over”

shot.title: The promised perfect day
shot.direction: A father and two daughters enter the museum beneath his imagined PERFECT DAY banner.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Wide natural-history museum. Father enters beside his two daughters, gesturing enthusiastically toward a large dinosaur exhibit at a safe distance. Older daughter holds his free hand; smaller child stays beside his leg. Show both children’s separate uncertain expressions, feet planted in the museum space.

shot.title: The model stirs
shot.direction: The dinosaur model makes one slow, basic lean; no chase is added.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Same museum and family. Dinosaur model has made one small forward lean, entirely within its exhibit. Older daughter points toward it, father turns his eyes to follow her finger, smaller daughter begins leaning backward. The dinosaur never chases or touches anyone.

beats.caption: This is going to be the greatest day ever.
beats.speaker: FATHER

shot.title: The greatest day
shot.direction: He gestures toward the exhibit, unaware of the children’s hesitation.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Wide natural-history museum. Father enters beside his two daughters, gesturing enthusiastically toward a large dinosaur exhibit at a safe distance. Older daughter holds his free hand; smaller child stays beside his leg. Show both children’s separate uncertain expressions, feet planted in the museum space.

shot.title: Is it moving
shot.direction: A daughter notices the motion; the father follows her pointing hand.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Same museum and family. Dinosaur model has made one small forward lean, entirely within its exhibit. Older daughter points toward it, father turns his eyes to follow her finger, smaller daughter begins leaning backward. The dinosaur never chases or touches anyone.

shot.title: A little too close
shot.direction: The second child reacts a beat later. Keep both individual reactions visible.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Both daughters move back toward father rather than fleeing through the museum. He bends his knees and lowers open arms to receive them, keeping balanced feet on the floor. Children retain separate faces and clothing. Fear is small and believable, not a gag or exaggerated screaming mask.

shot.title: The children run back
shot.direction: The daughters retreat toward the father; the perfection banner crumples.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Both daughters move back toward father rather than fleeing through the museum. He bends his knees and lowers open arms to receive them, keeping balanced feet on the floor. Children retain separate faces and clothing. Fear is small and believable, not a gag or exaggerated screaming mask.

shot.title: A parent lowers himself
shot.direction: He lowers to receive them instead of urging them to admire the model.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Father crouches at his daughters’ eye level in a quiet museum corner, one small hand held securely while the other child stays close. His face is apologetic and attentive; neither child is pressured to smile at the exhibit. Dinosaur remains distant and static.

beats.caption: I’m sorry. I thought you’d love it.
beats.speaker: FATHER

shot.title: I thought you would love it
shot.direction: He apologizes without asking the children to validate his plan.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Father crouches at his daughters’ eye level in a quiet museum corner, one small hand held securely while the other child stays close. His face is apologetic and attentive; neither child is pressured to smile at the exhibit. Dinosaur remains distant and static.

shot.title: A smaller room at night
shot.direction: Dissolve from the museum to a bedroom: reduce the scale and the level of light.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Later at night in a modest bedroom. Older daughter lies under a soft blanket, reaching one small hand toward father as he notices from the bedside. Smaller child sleeps quietly in a second bed deeper in frame. No dinosaur toy gag or museum fantasy intrudes.

shot.title: A hand beyond the blanket
shot.direction: A small hand reaches out from bed. The father notices and moves closer.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Later at night in a modest bedroom. Older daughter lies under a soft blanket, reaching one small hand toward father as he notices from the bedside. Smaller child sleeps quietly in a second bed deeper in frame. No dinosaur toy gag or museum fantasy intrudes.

beats.caption: Will you stay here until I fall asleep?
beats.speaker: DAUGHTER

shot.title: Stay until I sleep
shot.direction: Allow the request to be ordinary and direct, with no returning dinosaur gag.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Later at night in a modest bedroom. Older daughter lies under a soft blanket, reaching one small hand toward father as he notices from the bedside. Smaller child sleeps quietly in a second bed deeper in frame. No dinosaur toy gag or museum fantasy intrudes.

shot.title: Of course
shot.direction: He sits beside the bed, accepting an undramatic task.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

illustration.direction: Wide quiet bedroom. Father sits naturally on a sturdy chair beside older daughter’s bed, one hand resting gently near her offered hand, grounded feet and relaxed shoulders. Her body settles toward sleep. Smaller daughter stays asleep in her own bed; warm bedside lamp and steady ordinary presence.

shot.title: A steady presence
shot.direction: His hands become still; the child’s body relaxes toward sleep.
shot.soundDirection: Museum hall echo, theatrical dinosaur mechanism, quiet bedside air.

shot.title: The doorway is enough
shot.direction: Close with a steady parent, a quiet room, and no perfection banner.
